capabilities.name: deterministic-first hybrid architecture
capabilities.description: Use native system primitives and deterministic state machines first, with a bounded model fallback for ambiguity.

capabilities.name: native device interaction sequencing
capabilities.description: Decompose device interaction into invocation, input, observation, governed handoff, and verification boundaries.

capabilities.name: governed conversation loop
capabilities.description: Keep transcript admission, action dispatch, response output, and receipts distinct.

capabilities.name: concurrent governed conversational presence
capabilities.description: Keep speech, cognition, work, and continuity coordinated while preserving one Agent Lee identity.

capabilities.name: evidence-bound interruption and speech
capabilities.description: Distinguish backchannels from interruptions and prevent speculative speech from claiming unverified results.

capabilities.name: voice-path physical measurement
capabilities.description: Measure acoustic, electrical, channel, and thermal limits as SI quantities before Formula mapping.

contributions.statement: Prefer deterministic transport, state, validation, and transactional dispatch before semantic fallback.
Model native device control as an observable sequence with governed handoff and post-action verification.
Keep transcript admission, action dispatch, response output, and receipt evidence as separate boundaries.
Speech, cognition, work, and continuity are coordinated time-indexed loops under one Agent Lee identity.
Backchannels and floor-taking interruptions are distinct; a true interruption invalidates stale playback and updates active context.
Spoken output cannot claim a result is complete or verified before execution evidence exists.
Physical voice equations are measurement inputs and require calibration before they can influence a Formula mapping.

limits: Three user-supplied Gemini conversation exports are captured; this is not the entirety of Gemini's knowledge or training.
The exports' unsupported verified-status claims were not promoted without local proof.
This packet does not extract Gemini weights, hidden training, private reasoning, or provider internals.
No phone call or native-device action was executed from this capsule.
The voice-physics Formula layer is experimental shadow mathematics; it is not an active voice policy or production adapter.

provenance.notes: User-supplied conversation exports were hashed and summarized into bounded capability capsules; provider terms and commercial rights remain unreviewed.

admission.reason: Observed response exports captured and converted to non-authorizing native capability capsules; Formula shadow tests pass, while evaluation and rights gates remain pending.
